lavender.description: A fragrant Mediterranean herb with violet flowers and aromatic foliage.
lavender.medicalInfo: Lavender is commonly associated with calming, fragrance, and light herbal care.

nephrolepis.description: A lush fern with arching fronds that adds soft woodland texture.
nephrolepis.medicalInfo: Nephrolepis is mostly ornamental and humidity-loving; it is not a common medicinal herb.

santolina.description: A compact silver-green shrub for aromatic borders and dry gardens.
santolina.medicalInfo: Santolina is associated with aromatic foliage and traditional herbal use.

cactus.description: A highly drought-adapted succulent with water-storing tissues.
cactus.medicalInfo: Some cactus species are used as edible or medicinal plants, but use depends on the species.

giant_lotus.description: A large aquatic plant with floating leaves and very low drought tolerance.
giant_lotus.medicalInfo: The giant water lily is primarily an aquatic ornamental plant, not a common medicinal plant.

ginkgo.description: A resilient tree with fan-shaped leaves and strong cultural significance.
ginkgo.medicalInfo: Ginkgo leaves and seeds are widely associated with traditional medicine. Extracts are often discussed for circulation and memory support, but use should be guided by professional advice.
